FIFA Fines Spain Over Anti-Muslim Chants at Friendly Against Egypt

FIFA has imposed a $20,000 fine on Spain after fans directed an anti-Muslim chant during a friendly match against Egypt in Barcelona.

By LokkeeVerse · 1 min read

FIFA has fined Spain $20,000 following an incident in which spectators directed an anti-Muslim slogan during an international friendly match against Egypt held in Barcelona. According to reports, the penalty was issued against the Spanish federation after the chants took place during the warmup match. The incident also drew public condemnation from Spanish player Lamine Yamal.
